description: This Java class represents the domain entity for configuring interest recalculation settings for a loan product within the Apache Fineract system. It maps to the database table 'm_product_loan_recalculation_details' and contains fields for various interest recalculation parameters, including compounding, rescheduling, frequency, and other related strategies.

classes.name: LoanProductInterestRecalculationDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing the interest recalculation configuration for a loan product, including methods for construction and updating the associated loan product.

methods.name: LoanProductInterestRecalculationDetails
methods.description: Constructor initializing all interest recalculation settings.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Method to update the related loan product reference.

methods.name: getRestFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the frequency type for interest recalculation as an enum.

methods.name: getCompoundingFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the compounding frequency type as an enum.

methods.name: getPreCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the pre-close interest calculation strategy as an enum.
